game_updates.contents: Salvete Romans!Welcome to the first big update for Romestead, and the first milestone on our Roadmap! We are starting off with some in-depth explanations, then the patch notes for the update, and finally a section about what's ahead!In this update you can experience nearly everything without having to make a new world, but if you want a better dungeoneering experience, we highly recommend it! Thank you so much for playing Romestead and supporting us during the months since release! You have inspired many of these changes and we are greatful for all the suggestions, feedback, and comments on our posts that help us make Romestead better every day!Without further ado, let's get into it. game_updates.contents: After hopes that a new Deadlock update was imminent, Valve developer 'Yoshi' confirms it has "taken longer than expected" in playtesting. Read the full story on PCGamesN: Don't expect the next Deadlock update until "late September," Valve announces

game_updates.title: Mega Optimization Update
game_updates.contents: Enjoy higher FPS, the mega optimization update is here!New Physics Engine, mega fps boostWe converted the game to use the new Box3D physics engine.It roughly doubles FPS on large factories, and gives an insane FPS boost on mega factories which were previously unplayable. I tested it on a few different save files:This is a huge change to how the physics simulation works. We've been testing it for the past month, but there are likely to be issues with it that we haven't seen yet. If you notice any issues, please let us know! Steam Discussions & Discord are the best place to report bugs.Explosive BarrelsThese explosive barrels don't serve any real gameplay purpose currently. They're just a fun thing you can buy in the shop to play with the new physics engine!If you're in sandbox mode, you can...

game_updates.title: 3.26.3.9 Patch Notes
game_updates.contents: This security patch addresses a reported exploit that could affect players with the Steam Overlay disabled. As far as we're aware, the exploit has not been used in the wild. We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the timing of the update releasing shortly before the weekend. Credit TBD pending response from the reporter.

game_updates.title: 1.61 Update: Improved Material System Update
game_updates.contents: Today, we bring good news to our #BestCommunityEver! With the upcoming 1.61 update, the improved material system will be implemented on three additional trucks, so read on to find out more!We first introduced the improved material system with the 1.60 update, when it was added to the DAF NGD and MAN TG3 TGX in Euro Truck Simulator 2, and the Mack Anthem and Western Star 49X in American Truck Simulator. With the next update to our games, we will be expanding this feature to the International LT and International LoneStar in American Truck Simulator, as well as the Volvo FH Series 6 in Euro Truck Simulator 2!The improved material system significantly enhances the lighting and visual quality of vehicle interiors, with a particular focus on how different interior materials react to light. game_updates.title: Major Update #8: Wide Valley, Cows, Cider, Advanced Construction & More
game_updates.contents: Hey everyone, The latest update has successfully went through all the community Beta testing and is now ready for the main branch. For a summary of what we worked on, you can check out the previously published preview here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1363080/view/677378351435875655 Steam Reviews: Your Feedback MattersI've been reading a lot of reviews lately about the lack of new content, I hope this is at least a sign of a positive direction and if your review was negative, maybe we managed to change your mind. game_updates.title: Incoming Update: A Royal Wardrobe
game_updates.contents: Greetings, Queens and Kings, The finest tailors and blacksmiths from the realm have gathered to provide you with new attire to don while you protect your little Kingdom against your furious foes! Coming soon, in this update you’ll be able to customize your Ruler’s appearance. Choose from a range of crowns, armour and capes, then truly make them your own with unique colours and patterns. Of course your mount gets their own gear too… We want to thank you for your dedication, enthusiasm, and protection of the realm. We’re excited to share more updates with you all soon. In the meantime, make sure you join our official Discord channel and follow our socials for the latest updates from the Kingdom! See you on the battlefield come nightfall. The Mythwright team. game_updates.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered includes work from a top modder, as CD Projekt Red follow the path they walked with the RPG's next-gen update
game_updates.contents: As revealed earlier this week alongside a look at next year's Songs of the Past expansion, The Witcher 3 is getting a free remastered update next month. As with 2022's next-gen update, some of its tweaks and additions are the work of modders, with the creator of The Witcher 3's HD Reworked Project having revealed that they got the call to collaborate with CD Projekt Red again. game_updates.contents: TACTICAL. TURN-BASED. RAINBOW SIX. Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics is a single-player, turn-based tactical game set in the iconic Rainbow Six universe. Step into the role of commander, rebuild the unit, and deploy elite operators across dangerous missions worldwide to stop a shadowy conspiracy. https://store.steampowered.com/app/3621390 COMMAND OPERATOR SQUADS IN TENSE BATTLES https://ubistatic-a.akamaihd.net/0175/CRM/STEAM/SND/V1_B2.gif Assemble squads of operators, each with signature abilities and gear. Analyze the battlefield with recon tools, choose your approach, take part in tense, turn-based tactical battles, and use destructible environments to create new opportunities. Learn more

game_updates.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered: Everything new coming in the big free upgrade
game_updates.contents: fter 11 years, The Witcher 3 is getting a new story expansion and a remaster. CD Projekt Red has announced The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered, which is coming in 2026 and will be a free upgrade for all current owners of the game, paving the way for the shiny new DLC coming next year. It isn't just a technical update, either: CDPR is making changes to The Witcher 3's combat, skill system, and hey, transmogs!.. Read more.

game_updates.title: Apex Legends: Latest Update 8/26/2026
game_updates.contents: FIXED:-Octane passive once again restores him to full health, as intended.-Fixed rare instances where players were locked out of nearly all actions in Battle Royale mode.-Fixed an instance where Gibraltar could sprint faster than intended when combining Fast Shotties perk with the Corrupted Stock.-Fixed an issue where players would sometimes experience rubberbanding, jumpy behaviour and/or jittery movement after reconnecting.

game_updates.title: Yet Another Update 1.0.0c (HOTFIX)
game_updates.contents: Welcome, Survivor! We're releasing a hotfix update for some of the issues reported and feedback received since the version 1.0.0b, with the following changes: Additions: Reintroduced the option to delete/reset the first save game profile at the "Change Save Slot" interface. "Remap Controls" setting in Options -> Controls now allows you to bind "Speed up" and "Slow down" hotkeys (remember, that speeds below 100% automatically disable the Leaderboards). "FPS Counter" setting was added in Options -> Interface. "Hide Build Version" setting was added in Options -> Interface (also hides the "Press F8 to submit feedback" text where applicable).
